replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics has always felt like a rigid subject to me, distant from my passions for philosophy and literature. I find the lack of creativity in it unappealing, yet I understand its necessity. Growing up, my parents' limited education meant math was often just about getting through school, not exploring ideas.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, sometimes. The rigid logic and strict requirements make me feel stressed. Unlike philosophy where there are multiple angles to explore, math feels like there is only one right way, and that pressure makes me want to avoid it entirely.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I haven't used AI for math much. My preference is diving into literature or photography, not solving equations. However, I imagine it could help some people who struggle with it, though I prefer traditional methods that feel more human and less mechanical.
